##Figure 1A Change in Air Quality 2025 average vs 2015 averagae Nation Wide - PM2.5 (EPA AIR DATA PM2.5)

```{r}


##Palette (Diverging)
pal <- c("#204683", "#608ED8", "white", "#DD5A54", "#AF2A23") 
#dDATA SETUP AND CLEANUP 
PM2.5Change <- read.csv("~/Documents/es_314/SOE_Report_F2026/Student Coding/Frida/Data/pm.25_perc.csv")

class(PM2.5Change)


PM2.5Change_sf <- st_as_sf(
  PM2.5Change, 
  coords = c("Site.Longitude", "Site.Latitude"), 
  crs = 4326
)

# 2. Reproject to Massachusetts State Plane (6492)
PM2.5Change_sf <- st_transform(PM2.5Change_sf, crs = 6492)


```

Prediction Grid

```{r}
# create prediction grid
options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

ma <- states(cb = TRUE, year = 2023) |>
  subset(STUSPS == "MA")
suggest_crs(ma)
ma <- ma |> st_transform(6492)

grid <- terra::rast(ma, nrows = 200, ncols = 200)

xy <- terra::xyFromCell(grid, 1:ncell(grid)) |> as.data.frame()

pred_grid <- xy |> 
        st_as_sf( coords = c("x", "y"),
        crs = st_crs(grid))

# subset points that fall within 
pred_grid <- pred_grid[ma, ]

rm(xy)


nrow(PM2.5Change_sf)
st_crs(PM2.5Change_sf) == st_crs(ma)

ma <- st_transform(ma, st_crs(PM2.5Change_sf))

st_intersects(st_as_sfc(st_bbox(PM2.5Change_sf)), ma, sparse = FALSE)

```

#PM2.5 Figure

```{r}

ggplot() +
  geom_spatraster(data = pred_idw, aes(fill = mean)) +
scale_fill_gradientn(colors = pal, na.value = "transparent", name = "%Change") +
  geom_sf(data = PM2.5Change_sf, aes(color = percentage_change),  shape = 21,       
    color = "black",  # Outline color
    size = 3,         # Point size
    stroke = 0.5      # Outline thickness
  ) + theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(family = "Fraunces", size = 10,))



```
